# Security policy

Free, non-commercial personal project. No support, no service levels, and no commitment to maintenance or updates.

## Report a vulnerability

Report it **privately** through GitHub: open the *Security* tab of this repository and choose *Report a vulnerability* (GitHub's private vulnerability reporting). Please do not open a public issue with the details.

If the button is not shown, open a public issue that says only that you have a security report, with no details, and ask for a private way to send it.

A good report says which version you used (`harness-design-studio --version`), what you did, what happened and what you expected. Do not send design data of your own that you may not share.

## What to expect

Provided as is, without warranty of any kind. Check all results before you rely on them. See sections 15 and 16 of the GPL-3.0.

There is no promise of a reply time, a fix, a release date or any support. Reports are read at the owner's discretion. Only the newest release is looked at. Credit in a fix is given if you ask for it and the owner agrees.

## What the tool does about security

The tool runs offline, reads project folders and spreadsheets and writes files next to them. What it does and does not do, and the threats that were considered, are in [`HarnessDesignStudio/docs/SECURITY.md`](../HarnessDesignStudio/docs/SECURITY.md). How to check a download (checksum and signature): [`HarnessDesignStudio/docs/INSTALL.md`](../HarnessDesignStudio/docs/INSTALL.md).
